title: THE GOLDEN ENEMY IS GOLD AND ONLY WHERE SEEN
why: His standing order of 2026-10-14 (new features polished to the level of the rest of the game) and the cloud review finding 6. The golden enemy was lit and named by a floating HUD label even when it stood behind a wall or in the fog, and its body looked like any other machine. Its body now wears the elite outline in gold (a crisp inner line, a soft outer one, a faint tint), with a gold glow, a ring on the ground and sparkles drawn in the world under it, and all of it, the name too, only where its body is seen: the same sight rule as the body, a teammate sight counts.
now: The golden enemy looks golden now, and shows only where you can see it.
